tonal_arc: A small D-add-nine pluck identity becomes a recurring B-minor, G and A-suspended errand cell. The pulse ends before the reveal; open D-six/nine struck harmony answers, leaving space for the pour and fine fizz. A resolved D chord and A-to-D answer decay through the final readout.

narration_edits.text: You wanted a glass of soda. Somehow, that turned into a trip to the store. A case in the cart. Into the car. Into the kitchen. Onto a shelf. And when the cans are gone? Another trip. And another. And another. What if the next glass was already waiting? Cold. Fully carbonated. Straight from your faucet. The soda you wanted. Whenever you want it. Home Soda Machine. One less errand.
narration_edits.editing: One complete performance; no cuts, time stretching, or rearrangement.
